queries_run: BorgWarner largest customer second-source OR in-house OR insourcing 2026
BorgWarner customer insource eProducts power electronics OEM in-house 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 風險因素：競爭對手包含主要 OEM 客戶的垂直整合單位；多家主要 OEM 客戶已表明有意將公司生產的部分零組件自製（insource），OEM 已選擇且可能再選擇自製取代現有供應。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Although many OEMs have indicated that they will continue to rely on outside suppliers, a number of major OEM customers have indicated their intent to insource certain components that we produce, and many do manufacture products for their own uses that directly compete with our products.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：公司自身採購端使用 dual sourcing 等手段（屬供應端，非客戶對 BWA 導入第二供應商）。
findings.excerpt: the Company uses long-term contracts, cost sharing arrangements, design changes, dual sourcing, customer buy programs and limited financial instruments to help control costs.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到點名最大客戶導入第二供應商或自製 BWA 產品的具體公開來源；僅有 10-K 一般性 insource 風險揭露。另有搜尋摘要提及與歐洲 OEM 延長逆變器專案（Automotive World），未讀原文，不列為 finding。
